svg.title: Shackleton Station
svg.desc: An astronaut and the robot Volt outside a small base on the rim of Shackleton Crater at the Moon's south pole. The Sun sits on the horizon, so shadows stretch far; Earth hangs low in a black sky full of stars.

g.text: A MOON BASE ADVENTURE · NASA SPACE APPS 2026
Survive 4 days at the Moon’s south pole.

svg.text: At the south pole the Sun skims the horizon, so shadows stretch very far.
